description: TY2026 mfj family of 4 (FPL 15,650 + 3 x 5,500 = 32,150): income 60,000 -> 186.62% FPL (floor). Tier 150-200%: 4.19 + (6.60-4.19) x 3,662/5,000 = 4.19 + 1.77 = 5.96% -> contribution 3,576; PTC = min(15,000, 14,000 - 3,576) = 10,424. APTC 12,000 -> excess 1,576 repaid IN FULL: OBBBA SS 71305 struck the SS 36B(f)(2)(B) cap for 2026 (under prior law this household would have repaid at most $1,950).
